description: This file defines a mock class 'ServiceMock' which inherits from 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell' and uses Google Mock framework to mock various methods related to a service interface within the WPEFramework. The class is intended for unit testing and testing mocks, providing method signatures to simulate the behavior of the actual service interface.
